angle: Unlike abstract resampling summaries, this video builds every idea on one tiny n=8 drug example with a physical draw-and-replace walkthrough and a four-step recipe that transfers to any statistic.
angle_detail: Start with [02:28] through [05:00] to learn the resampling recipe itself, since everything later reuses it. Then watch [05:28] through [06:49] for the payoff, where the spread of resample means becomes the standard error and the band covering zero decides the example. Note the trap at [06:49]: the interval shown is a percentile band, never a t-interval, and the hypothesis-testing remarks around [07:02] belong to another unit, so do not file them under bootstrapping.
